description: Source code for the KeyValueGroupedDataset class and its implementation in Apache Spark SQL Connect module, including methods for grouping, aggregation, stateful processing, and internal encoders.

classes.name: KeyValueGroupedDataset
classes.description: Abstract class representing a grouped dataset with key-value pairs, providing methods for grouping, aggregation, and stateful operations.

classes.name: KeyValueGroupedDatasetImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for KeyValueGroupedDataset, managing internal plan, encoders, and transformation logic.

classes.name: EmptyInitialStateStruct
classes.description: Placeholder class used as a sentinel for initial state encoder when no initial state is provided.

methods.name: keyAs
methods.description: Returns a new KeyValueGroupedDataset with the key type mapped to a different type.

methods.name: mapValues
methods.description: Transforms the values in the grouped dataset using a provided function.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a Dataset of the grouping keys.

methods.name: flatMapSortedGroups
methods.description: Applies a flatMap operation on sorted groups with specified sorting expressions.

methods.name: reduceGroups
methods.description: Reduces the groups using a specified reduce function.

methods.name: cogroupSorted
methods.description: Performs a cogroup operation with sorted input datasets.

methods.name: mapGroupsWithState
methods.description: Applies a stateful mapGroups operation with optional initial state and timeout configuration.

methods.name: transformWithState
methods.description: Transforms the dataset with a custom stateful processor, supporting event time and initial state.

methods.name: reduceGroups
methods.description: Reduces the groups with a specified reduce function.

methods.name: agg
methods.description: Performs aggregation on the grouped dataset with specified columns.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of elements in each group.

methods.name: cogroup
methods.description: Performs a cogroup operation with another grouped dataset.

methods.name: transformWithStateHelper
methods.description: Internal method to handle stateful transformation logic.

methods.name: getUdf
methods.description: Creates a UDF expression for internal use with specified encoders.
